'''KU-Cook''' is a KU-Roro in charge of cooking and can be found downstairs the [[Haven of Sprouts]] "defending" itself.

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''KU-Cook:''' How many times do I have to tell you? NO MEANS NO!
:'''KU-Cook:''' These recipes you're uploading are gonna corrupt the Tethys System! No more weird recipes!
:Black Shore Member: Calm down, KU-Cook. Take a breath.
:Black Shore Member: You know... technically speaking, Coral Bowl is rich in nutrients. You just have to...
:'''KU-Cook:''' Ahhhh! Somebody erase those words from my memory!

;(Near by)
:Black Shore Member: Ah... finally a break. I can't even remember the last time I got to enjoy something KU-Cook made.
:Black Shore Member: KU-Cook's still going strong. Right now it's scolding someone for uploading bizarre recipes again.
:Black Shore Member: This is the kind of peace we've all been longing for.
{{Dialogue End}}

==Note==
* Coral Bowl references [[Encore/Backstory#Cherished Items|Encore]] specialty dish.
